summary_1line: Bhishma explains marriage, dowry, women’s status, and inheritance rules, arguing daughters and daughters’ sons can inherit while condemning selling daughters or forced unions.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged Bhishma lies upon his bed of arrows while instructing Yudhishthira about the duties of marriage and inheritance.
A solemn father places ornaments upon his daughter as she is respectfully given in marriage before gathered kin.
Women of a household weep together in a dim courtyard as their grief is said to bring ruin upon the family.
